hardening.minimized_reason: Omit npm/npx, inspector, SEA, Brotli/Zstd implementations and unused subpackages. Omit node:ffi while retaining native addons, SQLite and TypeScript.
hardening.pledge_reason: Built-in capability groups deny operations until root-held allowance files grant them; this is independent of the service form.

changes.what: Omit npm/npx, inspector, SEA and unused subpackages.
changes.why: Keep the server runtime without package installation and debugging entrypoints.

changes.what: Ignore runtime environment options, refuse effective-root initialization, and gate execution, native loading, inline input and writable modules.
changes.why: Require explicit root-held allowances for dangerous runtime capability groups.

changes.what: Omit native Brotli/Zstd codecs and negotiate only available HTTP content encodings.
changes.why: The deployed applications use gzip/deflate; unavailable decoders must not be linked or advertised.
Keep native addons used by n8n without an additional general-purpose FFI entrypoint.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi ships equivalent policy and installed-package probes verify it; review before retiring this overlay.
